messages:
jane: quick RFC follow-up — we need a concrete path for v1 API keys -> token-v2 for both user keys and service tokens. i want minimal surprises for infra and customers.

cory: agree. proposed constraints: stop issuing v1 immediately, continue accepting v1 for 60 days, provide an explicit exchange endpoint, and a bulk-admin exchange for service accounts.

marie: exchange endpoint should be idempotent and return the canonical actor id + role snapshot so callers can verify no privilege drift. include a Migration-Score header.

rahul: SRE notes: bulk exchange must be rate-limited and resumable. add dry-run mode and produce an audit CSV (old_key, new_token, actor_id, roles). we'll run dry-run on a staging slice before prod.

jane: on naming: we need deterministic, short handles for console + logs. suggestion: project-abbrev:env:purpose:8hex (no user emails). keep total length under 64.

cory: SDKs should auto-call exchange on first auth attempt if they see deprecation headers. but SDKs must surface a warning to avoid silent failures.

marie: RBAC compatibility: exchange must accept a flag `preserve_binding=true` which ties the new token to the same actor principal id and roles. otherwise operators can request scoped tokens. record both pre and post binding snapshots in audit trail.

rahul: ops-bot: created checklist: create exchange endpoint -> canary -> monitor for 72h -> bulk-exchange dry-run -> full rollout. runbook: https://go.redwood/cred-migrate.

jane: telemetry: cred.exchange.request, cred.exchange.success, cred.v1.used (deprecated). alert if >1% v1 usage after 14 days post-issue-block.

cory: security nit: ensure token-v2 uses different signing key family and is asymmetric if possible. rotate signing keys as part of migration window.

marie: UX: console add a migration column with score + recommended action. project admins can approve bulk exchange. provide an escape hatch (support request -> extended compat) for relying parties.

rahul: action items: 1) spec exchange API + headers (owner: jane) 2) bulk-admin CLI + dry-run (owner: rahul) 3) SDK auto-exchange PRs + warnings (owner: cory) 4) naming spec & console surface (owner: marie) 5) telemetry + alerts (owner: jane). i'll schedule a 30m sync after specs land.

jane: thanks — please drop any blockers here by EOD. otherwise i'll post the follow-up RFC with concrete API examples and rollout timeline.
